nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon Foreground
nodes.rationale: Front layer of the Android adaptive launcher icon: the blue gradient chevron alone on transparency, centred inside the safe zone so Android can mask and parallax it over the background layer.

nodes.label: Glossy Blue Chevron / Caret Mark
nodes.rationale: Rounded upward-pointing chevron with a dark-to-light blue gradient and soft drop shadow; this is the default Expo template mark rather than a checklist-specific symbol.
